name: Etna Comics
blurb: Southern Italy's largest comics and pop-culture festival, held in Catania with cosplay, games, film and manga programming.

editions.evidence: Homepage meta description: 'Scopri Etna Comics 2027 dal 3 al 6 Giugno a Catania, insieme a noi la 15° Edizione del Festival internazionale del fumetto, del gioco e della cultura pop'

notes: No dedicated guest-announcement page found yet for the 2027 (15th) edition; the rendered homepage still shows mostly 2026 recap content alongside the 2027 date announcement, and no venue name was stated (only a Catania contact address).
